status_help: conditioning + entries; not yet in the shape
got it — with a spotter, crash mat or one good side
repeatable both sides, controlled entry and exit, toes pointed
level_notes: L1 not yet holding full bodyweight · L2 working toward a solid invert · L3 solid invert, working toward Ayesha · L4 solid Ayesha, working toward Iron X / Phoenix · L5 competition-grade strength and flexibility elements

skills.name: Pole grips (split · bracket · cup · twisted · elbow)
skills.how: Learn the five grips every trick is built on: split/half-bracket, full bracket, cup, twisted, elbow.
skills.cues: Pull with the top arm, push with the bottom. Wrists stacked, never bent back.
skills.watch: Twisted grip loads the shoulder in an odd position — warm it up, never rush it.

skills.name: Pole conditioning basics
skills.how: Pole holds, tuck lifts, climbs-in-place, push-pull drills — 10–15 min at the end of every session.
skills.cues: Shoulders down and back; engage before you load.
skills.watch: Grip fatigue comes first — stop the tricks when the grip goes.

skills.name: Half & full bracket grip hold
skills.how: Top hand above head, bottom hand at hip height pushing away — the base grip for chair, butterfly, handspring.
skills.cues: Bottom arm straight and pushing; hips lift because the arms push, not because you jump.
skills.watch: Bent bottom elbow collapses the hold.

skills.name: Forearm grip (climbs & transitions)
skills.how: Forearm wraps the pole at chest height; used for climbs, sits and later Ayesha variations.
skills.cues: Squeeze pole into the crook of the elbow; chest stays close.
skills.watch: Skin burn early on — build up gradually.

skills.name: Invert conditioning (tucks · pole crunches · leg lifts)
skills.how: Knee tucks hanging from the pole, pole crunches, straight-leg lifts — the strength behind every clean invert.
skills.cues: Tilt the hips up; let the shoulders stay low.
skills.watch: Kicking up hides weakness — earn the no-kick version.

skills.name: Fireman Spin
skills.how: Step, hook both legs around the pole and ride the spin down.
skills.cues: Step away from the pole to get momentum; both hands high.
skills.watch: Clamping the knees kills the spin.

skills.name: Chair Spin
skills.how: Half-bracket grip; knees lift to 90° as you spin — sitting in an invisible chair.
skills.cues: Push the bottom arm to keep the hips away from the pole.
skills.watch: Rounded shoulders; look up and out.

skills.name: Back Hook Spin
skills.how: Outside leg hooks the pole behind the knee as you step around, other leg extends.
skills.cues: Lean back into the hook; point the free leg.
skills.watch: Hooking too high on the thigh slides.

skills.name: Front Hook Spin
skills.how: Inside leg hooks in front of the pole; body arcs away.
skills.cues: Step wide before the hook; keep the chest lifted.
skills.watch: Hook slips when the knee isn't wrapped fully.

skills.name: Attitude Spin
skills.how: Spin-pole classic: bracket grip, back leg bent in attitude, front leg straight.
skills.cues: Glutes squeezed to hold the shape.
skills.watch: Static version needs a real push-off.

skills.name: Reverse Grab / Spiral
skills.how: Walk backward, reach back to grab the pole overhead and spiral down.
skills.cues: Grab high, lean into the shoulder, let the legs trail.
skills.watch: Hard on the shoulder — learn it well before repeating it a lot.

skills.name: Ballerina
skills.how: Twisted grip on top, hips away from the pole, one leg bent behind — the music-box pose.
skills.cues: Lift the chest; push the hips forward and away.
skills.watch: First twisted-grip shape — warm the shoulder.

skills.name: Twisted Ballerina
skills.how: Ballerina with the body twisted to face away; photo favourite.
skills.cues: Rotate from the ribs, not just the hips.
skills.watch: Grip fatigue — take it early in the session.

skills.name: Pencil Spin
skills.how: Body vertical, legs together off the pole; assisted (foot on pole) first, then free.
skills.cues: Squeeze legs, hollow body; the higher the grip the easier.
skills.watch: Sagging hips — this is a straight-line drill.

skills.name: Marion Amber
skills.how: Dynamic shoulder-lean spin/transition into a split shape.
skills.cues: Commit the shoulder; the momentum does the lift.
skills.watch: Advanced entry — spot the first attempts.

skills.name: Phoenix
skills.how: Blind-grab spinning lift straight into a twisted-grip Ayesha.
skills.cues: Reach back, then pull and push simultaneously as you rise.
skills.watch: Marker skill for Elite on most level ladders.

skills.name: Basic Climb
skills.how: Step, hook, stand — reach, hook, stand. Feet and knees grip, arms guide.
skills.cues: Push down through the feet; don't pull yourself up with the arms.
skills.watch: Grip with the ankle bones, not the shins.

skills.name: Pole Sit
skills.how: From a climb, cross the pole behind one thigh and sit; hands go free.
skills.cues: Squeeze inner thighs; sit tall.
skills.watch: It hurts at first — it stops hurting.

skills.name: Crucifix (upright)
skills.how: Pole clamped between thighs and the back of one knee; arms open wide.
skills.cues: Cross the ankles and squeeze; hips forward.
skills.watch: Pinch-point bruising — pad up.

skills.name: Layback / Cross Ankle Release
skills.how: From a sit, cross ankles behind the pole and lean back until hands release.
skills.cues: Squeeze knees and ankles; go down slowly.
skills.watch: Mat under you; spotter the first times.

skills.name: Cross Knee Release
skills.how: Legs crossed at the knees around the pole, upper body releases backward.
skills.cues: Top knee pressing down is the lock.
skills.watch: Foundational — dozens of shapes hang off it.

skills.name: Thigh Hold
skills.how: Pole pinched between the thighs, body leaning away, hands off.
skills.cues: Squeeze from the adductors; hinge from the hip.
skills.watch: Slides when the pole sits too low on the leg.

skills.name: Knee Hold
skills.how: Pole behind one knee, other leg braces; torso leans out hands-free.
skills.cues: Flex the hooking foot hard.
skills.watch: Intermediate on most syllabi despite looking simple.

skills.name: Hip Hold / Jackknife
skills.how: Pole across the hip crease, body folded over it hands-free; base for Jade and Superman.
skills.cues: Fold at the hip; press the pole into the hip bone.
skills.watch: Placement is everything — too high and you roll.

skills.name: Cupid
skills.how: Standing on one foot on the pole, other knee hooks, body arcs away.
skills.cues: Push the standing foot down; drive the hips forward.
skills.watch: Basic but understated — very common compulsory shape.

skills.name: Jamilla / Apprentice
skills.how: Side-facing hang: one leg hooked, torso along the pole, arms free.
skills.cues: Squeeze the pole with the armpit and hooked leg.
skills.watch: Gateway to inverted transitions.

skills.name: Hood Ornament / Figurehead
skills.how: From a sit, arch back over the pole with legs in a pretty line.
skills.cues: Chest up, back leg long.
skills.watch: Also called Ice Skater — same shape.

skills.name: Teddy
skills.how: Seated hug of the pole with legs folded — the bear.
skills.cues: Elbow grip and thigh squeeze share the load.
skills.watch: Variations: Teddy Lili, Modest Bear.

skills.name: Caterpillar Climb
skills.how: Inverted climb: hands walk up while legs re-grip in a crucifix hold.
skills.cues: Hips stay close to the pole; small hand steps.
skills.watch: Inverting is NOT a prerequisite for the floor version.

skills.name: Chinese Climb
skills.how: Pole on the side of the body, climbing without the crotch grip — sport-pole style.
skills.cues: Elbow and knee squeeze; hips stacked.
skills.watch: Builds Chinese Flag strength.

skills.name: Tabletop
skills.how: Body horizontal like a table, pole under the hip and forearm.
skills.cues: Squeeze the pole into the forearm; hips high.
skills.watch: Tabletop Tuck is the one-hand illusion version.

skills.name: Basic Invert (Chopper / V)
skills.how: Hips tilt up past the shoulders, legs open into a V — your first upside-down.
skills.cues: Hips first, legs second; no kick.
skills.watch: THE gateway move; every leg hang lives above it.
skills.note: Solid invert = the line between Beginner+ and Intermediate.

skills.name: Inverted Crucifix
skills.how: From the invert, legs cross and clamp the pole; arms open, head down.
skills.cues: Squeeze knees and ankles before you let go.
skills.watch: Mat + spotter until the leg lock is automatic.

skills.name: Gemini (Outside Leg Hang)
skills.how: Hang from the outside leg hooked at the knee, body along the pole.
skills.cues: Flex the foot, press the thigh in, lean the torso away.
skills.watch: Contact point = back of knee + inner thigh, not the calf.

skills.name: Scorpio (Inside Leg Hang)
skills.how: Hang from the inside leg, pole across the hip, back arched.
skills.cues: Squeeze the pole with the hip crease and thigh.
skills.watch: Prerequisite for Allegra, Jade, Superman.

skills.name: Leg switch (Gemini ↔ Scorpio)
skills.how: Swap the hooking leg while inverted without touching down.
skills.cues: Grab the pole, re-invert slightly, exchange the hook.
skills.watch: The transition that makes combos possible.

skills.name: Butterfly
skills.how: Inverted with one leg hooked, split grip, other leg extended to the side.
skills.cues: Push the bottom arm; hips away from the pole.
skills.watch: Needs a lot of skin contact — bare legs.

skills.name: Extended Butterfly
skills.how: Butterfly with the hooked leg released — only hands and the extended leg's foot on the pole.
skills.cues: Push hard with the bottom arm; point the free leg to the ceiling.
skills.watch: Have a really strong Butterfly first.

skills.name: Superman
skills.how: Face-down horizontal, pole across the thighs and under the arm; flying.
skills.cues: Squeeze the pole between the thighs; arch and reach.
skills.watch: Thigh burn is the price of entry.

skills.name: Shoulder Mount
skills.how: Pole behind the shoulder, hands in cup grip; legs lift up and over.
skills.cues: Tuck first, then extend; drive the hips up.
skills.watch: Strength move — condition it, don't fling it.

skills.name: Aerial Invert
skills.how: Invert from a climb, feet off the ground, no kick.
skills.cues: Bring knees to chest before tilting.
skills.watch: Counts as the 'real' invert on sport ladders.

skills.name: Inverted D
skills.how: Inverted split grip, body curved away in a D — the Ayesha prep.
skills.cues: Bottom arm pushes; legs together and long.
skills.watch: Feels the Ayesha push without the balance risk.

skills.name: Brass Monkey
skills.how: Inverted hold on the back of one knee and the armpit, other leg free.
skills.cues: Squeeze pole into the armpit; flex the hooked foot.
skills.watch: Eight-plus entries — pick the one your body likes.

skills.name: Flatline Scorpio
skills.how: Scorpio with an elbow grip and the body flattened parallel to the floor.
skills.cues: Elbow grip tight; open the hip.
skills.watch: Leads into Superman and Brass Monkey combos.

skills.name: Iguana Mount
skills.how: Back to the pole, hands behind you, press up into an invert.
skills.cues: Chest through the arms; legs lead.
skills.watch: Works triceps and abs hard — a compulsory-style mount.

skills.name: Butterfly Handstand
skills.how: Hands on the floor, one leg hooked on the pole — a supported handstand.
skills.cues: Push the floor away; stack hips over shoulders.
skills.watch: Gentle intro to being upside down; leads to Butterfly.

skills.name: Aerial Shoulder Mount
skills.how: Shoulder mount with the feet already off the floor.
skills.cues: Set the shoulder first, then tuck and roll up.
skills.watch: Big strength jump from the floor version.

skills.name: Shoulder Mount Flip
skills.how: Cartwheel-style flip through the shoulder mount grip.
skills.cues: Momentum from the legs, control from the grip.
skills.watch: Works on static and spin; solid shoulder mount first.

skills.name: Jade Split
skills.how: From an outside leg hang, open into a split along the pole.
skills.cues: Pull the top leg with the hand; push the hip forward for a flat line.
skills.watch: Front split flexibility caps the shape.

skills.name: Allegra
skills.how: From inside leg hang, grab the ankle behind and open into a split shape.
skills.cues: Pole into the hip crease; pull the back foot.
skills.watch: Solid Scorpio first.

skills.name: Cocoon
skills.how: Folded shape wrapped around the pole, foot to head.
skills.cues: Round then open the back; breathe.
skills.watch: Back and shoulder mobility do the work.

skills.name: Chopsticks
skills.how: Both legs extended together off the pole in a straddle-split line — no invert needed.
skills.cues: Glutes on; legs long.
skills.watch: Great compulsory shape for straddle flexibility.

skills.name: Dove
skills.how: Kneeling-style backbend shape on the pole, foot reaching the head.
skills.cues: Chest open, shoulders back.
skills.watch: Some back flexibility is needed.

skills.name: Reiko Split
skills.how: Chinese-pole split: standing split along the pole, hands gripping.
skills.cues: Front split line; push the hip through.
skills.watch: Reiko → Ayesha is a classic combo.

skills.name: Shooting Star
skills.how: Jasmine-based extended shape reaching away from the pole.
skills.cues: Long lines; pole into the side.
skills.watch: PDC syllabus level 4.

skills.name: Eagle
skills.how: Foot pulled to the head behind the pole, chest open — flexibility showpiece.
skills.cues: Shoulder mobility first, then back.
skills.watch: Warm the back thoroughly.

skills.name: Yogini
skills.how: Flying, arched shape — legs and arms reaching, pole along the side body.
skills.cues: Squeeze the pole with the side; arch from the upper back.
skills.watch: Three levels of Yogini exist — pick yours.

skills.name: Russian Split
skills.how: Front split along the pole, upper body upright in a strong grip.
skills.cues: Front split + upper body strength + hamstrings.
skills.watch: 'Not hard' once the split is there — the split is the hard part.

skills.name: Pegasus
skills.how: Marlo Fisken's split shape, legs opening away from the pole hands-free.
skills.cues: Hip on the pole; open the split slowly.
skills.watch: Three-part tutorial series worth following.

skills.name: Bird of Paradise
skills.how: Standing-split shape wrapped on the pole; upright and downright versions.
skills.cues: Bind the leg then extend.
skills.watch: Strength AND flexibility — both must be there.

skills.name: Dragon's Tail
skills.how: Split shape from leg hangs, tail leg curling around the pole.
skills.cues: Solid inside AND outside leg hang first.
skills.watch: Broken Dragon is the harder cousin.

skills.name: Janeiro
skills.how: Split with the pole across the ribs and one leg hooked — the 'rib breaker'.
skills.cues: Pole under the ribs, not on them.
skills.watch: Janeiro → Jenko is the advanced follow-on.

skills.name: Rainbow Marchenko
skills.how: Foot to head in a full backbend while hanging by the other leg.
skills.cues: Back, shoulders and hip flexors all at end range.
skills.watch: Prep flexibility separately for months.

skills.name: Spatchcock
skills.how: Flat straddle with the pole through the middle of the split.
skills.cues: Middle split + hip external rotation.
skills.watch: Entries from Scorpio or Shoulder Mount.

skills.name: Ayesha (twisted grip)
skills.how: Inverted straddle held only by the hands in twisted grip.
skills.cues: Top arm pulls, bottom arm pushes; hips over hands.
skills.watch: Solid Ayesha = the Intermediate → Advanced line.
skills.note: Solid Ayesha is the marker between Intermediate and Advanced.

skills.name: Ayesha (cup grip / true grip)
skills.how: Same shape, shoulder-friendlier grips — cup grip is the sport-pole standard.
skills.cues: Cup grip pushes; keep the bottom arm long.
skills.watch: Regrip Ayesha → cup grip is the Iron X road.

skills.name: Starfish
skills.how: Body open in an X on the pole, held by hip and hand.
skills.cues: Pole across the hip bone; push the free limbs away.
skills.watch: Leads into Superman transitions.

skills.name: Batwing
skills.how: Inverted straddle held by the armpit/elbow grip.
skills.cues: Pole deep in the armpit; squeeze the lat.
skills.watch: Advanced invert on most ladders.

skills.name: Human Flag
skills.how: Body horizontal off the pole, held by two hands in a bracket.
skills.cues: Bottom arm locked and pushing; lats on.
skills.watch: Progress from tucked → straddle → full.

skills.name: Chinese Flag
skills.how: Flag held with the leg and elbow squeeze — sport-pole compulsory.
skills.cues: Squeeze the pole between elbow and knee; hips stacked.
skills.watch: Straddle version is the advanced variant.

skills.name: Iron X
skills.how: Horizontal straddle X held by the hands alone.
skills.cues: From aerial Ayesha: lower the hips while pushing the bottom arm.
skills.watch: Marker skill for Elite; core training is the bottleneck.

skills.name: Handspring (twisted grip)
skills.how: Kick or press from the floor into an Ayesha-style hold.
skills.cues: Hips over hands before the legs open.
skills.watch: Get the prep drills solid — most struggle here for months.

skills.name: True Grip / Cup Grip Handspring
skills.how: Handspring without the twist — shoulder-safe and the sport standard.
skills.cues: Push the bottom arm down the pole as you rise.
skills.watch: Harder than twisted grip, kinder to the shoulder.

skills.name: Machine Gun
skills.how: Dynamic climbing motion with the legs firing — advanced climb.
skills.cues: Rhythm over strength.
skills.watch: Advanced on every ladder.

skills.name: Deadlift (to Ayesha)
skills.how: Lift from a seated or hanging start to an aerial Ayesha with no swing.
skills.cues: Push-pull with the arms while the legs lift over.
skills.watch: Only with good technique, stability and active shoulder mobility.

skills.name: Fonji
skills.how: Release-and-regrab flip around the pole.
skills.cues: Ten drills before the first attempt.
skills.watch: Elite dynamic element; crash mat.
